title: POV: Christmas Is 8 Weeks Away… and Your $600 Is Already Saved 🎄

lines: Every December, Mia says the same thing. Christmas snuck up on me again.
scenes.img: a young woman with a ponytail in a busy shopping mall with Christmas decorations, carrying many shopping bags, stressed face, vertical composition

lines: So she puts nine hundred dollars of gifts on her credit card.
scenes.img: a young woman with a ponytail at a store checkout handing over a credit card, worried face, Christmas lights, vertical composition

lines: At twenty two percent, paying it off slowly can cost her a hundred dollars or more in interest.
scenes.img: a young woman with a ponytail in January looking at a credit card bill in shock, snow outside the window, vertical composition

lines: But Christmas isn't a surprise. It's on the same day every year.
scenes.img: {HERO} pointing calmly at a wall calendar with December 25 circled, cozy room, vertical composition

lines: So back in January, you opened a separate savings account. You called it Christmas.
scenes.img: {HERO} on a couch opening a savings account on his phone, calm small smile, winter scarf on the chair, vertical composition

lines: Fifty dollars a month, on autopilot. By December, that's six hundred dollars, waiting.
scenes.img: {HERO} watching a jar with a red bow slowly fill with coins, happy calm face, vertical composition

lines: Starting late? It's not too late. Forty dollars a week for eight weeks is three hundred twenty dollars.
scenes.img: {HERO} dropping a few bills into a jar with a red bow, Christmas lights in the background, vertical composition

lines: Same Christmas. Zero debt in January. Follow for one simple money move every day!
scenes.img: {HERO} handing a wrapped gift to a friend in a cozy living room with a Christmas tree, warm smile, vertical composition
